data.name: FS
data.description: FS (FS Agrisolutions / FS Bioenergia) is Brazil's fourth-largest ethanol producer, operating three corn-ethanol biorefineries in Mato Grosso with ~2.3 billion liters/year capacity plus animal nutrition (DDG), corn oil and bioelectricity. The company is developing Brazil's first BECCS project at its Lucas do Rio Verde plant, planning to capture fermentation CO2 and inject it ~800m+ underground in the Diamantino/Parecis Basin formation, with startup targeted for mid-2026. BECCS is a bolt-on to their core ethanol business rather than their primary activity.
